lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Launch and diagnostic: congruence defined by rigid motion

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read the example first. You are not expected to know this yet.

items.prompt: Two sides and the included angle are congruent. Which criterion?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Try each one. If you get stuck, write what you do know and move on.

items.prompt: Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.
Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 46° and ∠B = 29°. Find ∠F.
A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: maps every figure to a similar figure
preserves distance and angle measure
preserves area but may change side lengths
preserves shape but may change size

items.prompt: In two triangles, the hypotenuses and one pair of legs of two right triangles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
choices: SSS
ASA
SAS
HL

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and the pair of included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
choices: ASA
AAS
SSS
SAS

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Show what you can do so far. This sets the starting point, not a grade.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 40° and ∠B = 20°. Find ∠F.
If a sequence of rigid motions maps △ABC onto △DEF, then …
choices: every pair of corresponding sides and angles is congruent
only the corresponding sides are congruent
only the corresponding angles are congruent
the triangles have equal area but need not be congruent
